vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: insightfulpipe
Version: 0.1.1

The skill is a legitimate integration for the InsightfulPipe marketing data platform, providing a CLI wrapper for querying and managing data across various marketing services. The instructions in SKILL.md are well-structured, follow standard authentication patterns using environment variables (INSIGHTFULPIPE_TOKEN), and do not contain any indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's requested token and runtime instructions match its stated purpose (a marketing-data CLI); there are no unexplained environment variables or hidden installs, but standard cautions about installing npm packages and granting broad API tokens apply.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (marketing data across many platforms) align with the SKILL.md: commands for discovering platforms, querying data, and executing write actions. The only required env var is INSIGHTFULPIPE_TOKEN, which is appropriate for an API-based aggregator.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are focused on installing/using the insightfulpipe CLI, obtaining schemas, running read queries, and performing write actions. They do not instruct the agent to read unrelated files or environment variables. Note: the SKILL explicitly allows write operations (action <platform> --yes), which can modify remote accounts if the token has privileges.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No formal install spec in the registry metadata, but SKILL.md instructs 'npm install -g insightfulpipe' from npmjs.com. npm is a common distribution channel (moderate risk); installing a global package runs third-party code on the host — review the package source and consider non-global or sandboxed installs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only INSIGHTFULPIPE_TOKEN is required, which is proportionate. However this single token likely grants broad read/write access across connected marketing platforms — ensure the token follows least privilege and consider creating a read-only token if available.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-on and does not request persistent system-wide privileges. It is user-invocable and can be invoked autonomously per platform defaults; because the CLI supports destructive remote actions, allowlist/consent controls for write operations are recommended.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent with its description, but take these precautions before installing or enabling it: 1) Inspect the npm package (repository, maintainers, recent versions) before running npm install -g — prefer a review or non-global/sandboxed install. 2) Treat INSIGHTFULPIPE_TOKEN as powerful: create a least-privilege/read-only token if possible, and avoid using a token that can perform destructive actions unless strictly necessary. 3) Be cautious about allowing the agent to run write commands (insightfulpipe action ...) autonomously — require manual confirmation for any --yes operations or restrict the skill to read-only usage. 4) Rotate and revoke the token if you later stop using the service or suspect misuse. If you want stronger assurance, provide the package source (GitHub repo) and the exact token permission model so you can be advised more precisely.
